dossier.headline: Tata Steel sells tubes and Colours units to APL Apollo; both stocks slump
dossier.summary: Tata Steel agreed to sell its tubes business and its Tata Steel Colours stake to APL Apollo, in a deal reported at up to ₹28,000 crore and subject to regulatory clearances, with completion expected by March 2028. Tata Steel closed down 8.52% on 23 Nov as the biggest Sensex loser, and on 25 Nov it was the top Nifty loser again even as the market rebounded strongly, while APL Apollo hit a 52-week low.
why_it_matters: Tata Steel was the single largest drag on the Sensex in the 23 Nov sell-off and missed the 25 Nov rebound
The deal reshapes the steel-tubes market by moving Tata Steel's business to APL Apollo

Intraday move: the 1135 note had Tata Steel down 5% at 11:00, while the 1205 note had a day's low of ₹169.56, down 4.7%
APL Apollo's early fall: Business Upturn reported -7.85% while Business Standard reported a 10% lower circuit
Ownership: one report says Tata Steel will take a 26.38% stake in APL Apollo at ₹2,100 a share; this was not confirmed by other notes
